scope: SQL/name projection only; original old native results remain in the final-review batch.

records.name: reported_unparenthesized
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE NULL IS NULL COLLATE NOCASE;

records.name: reported_parenthesized_predicate
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE (NULL IS NULL) COLLATE NOCASE;

records.name: parenthesized_rhs
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE NULL IS (NULL COLLATE NOCASE);

records.name: is_not_null_collate
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE 0 IS NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE;

records.name: plain_is_null
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE NULL IS NULL;

records.name: string_rhs_collate
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE 'A' IS 'a' COLLATE NOCASE;

records.name: string_predicate_collate
records.sql: SELECT 7 AS n WHERE ('A' IS 'a') COLLATE NOCASE;

records.name: escape_null
records.sql: SELECT 'a' LIKE 'a' ESCAPE NULL COLLATE NOCASE AS n

records.name: escape_literal
records.sql: SELECT 'a_' LIKE 'ax_' ESCAPE 'x' COLLATE NOCASE AS n

records.name: escape_expression
records.sql: SELECT 'a' LIKE 'a' ESCAPE 'x' || '' COLLATE BINARY AS n

records.name: escape_predicate_parentheses
records.sql: SELECT ('a' LIKE 'a' ESCAPE 'x') COLLATE NOCASE AS n
